alvo.gramatica: the height / length / width / depth / weight of + nome
alvo.foco: usar substantivos de medida com the height of e the length of (suit, ruler, lab, tape, garage, size)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende os substantivos: What is the height of the suit? Measure the length of the table. Measure the width of the door.
falas: Hank, what is the height of the suit?
Measure the length of the table first.
The width of the door is very small.

alvo.gramatica: Dear …, · Best regards, · Kind regards, · Yours sincerely,
alvo.foco: escrever e-mails com Dear e Best regards (letter, envelope, stamp, mailbox, pen pal, address)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende o formato do e-mail: Dear Mr. Green, thank you. Best regards, Charlie. Kind regards, Lucy.
falas: What are you writing, Charlie Brown?
A letter to my pen pal.

alvo.gramatica: I'm afraid I have to cancel · Can we reschedule? · Unfortunately…
alvo.foco: cancelar planos com I am afraid I have to cancel e Can we reschedule (cancel, reschedule, unfortunately, sorry, tomorrow, meeting)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a cancelar: I am afraid I have to cancel. Unfortunately I am busy. Can we reschedule? I am so sorry.
falas: I'm afraid I have to cancel.

alvo.gramatica: I'd like a window seat · Can I check this bag?
alvo.foco: fazer check-in com I would like a window seat e Can I check this bag (luggage, seat, window, tag, scale, counter)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende no balcão: I would like a window seat, please. Can I check this bag? Put the bag on the scale.
falas: Good morning. Can I help you?
I would like a window seat, please.

alvo.gramatica: next to · across from · behind · on the corner
alvo.foco: mostrar o bairro com next to, across from e behind (library, bakery, bank, corner, block, neighbor)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a apresentar o bairro: The bakery is next to the bank. The library is across from the park. The shop is on the corner.
falas: What detail should we keep in mind?
It is a song, so the context changes how we read the scene.

alvo.gramatica: Slow down · Stop at the red light · speed limit
alvo.foco: regras de trânsito com speed limit, seat belt e slow down (speed limit, seat belt, red light, slow down, lane, park)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende regras de trânsito: Fasten your seat belt. Slow down. Stop at the red light. The speed limit is fifty.
falas: Done. What is the speed limit?

alvo.gramatica: One way · Dead end · Yield · Detour
alvo.foco: entender placas de estrada como One way, Dead end e Yield (one way, dead end, yield, merge, detour, exit)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende placas de estrada: One way, Dead end, Yield, Detour e Exit. O que cada uma quer dizer?
falas: This is a one way street.

alvo.gramatica: pass the test · fail the test · retake it
alvo.foco: falar de prova e resultado com pass, fail e retake (pass, fail, take a test, mark, study, result)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a falar de prova: I took the test. I passed! He failed the test, so he will retake it. What was your mark?
falas: I passed! My mark was ninety.

alvo.titulo: Com que frequência · The Son of Man
alvo.gramatica: every other day · once in a while · on weekdays
alvo.foco: frequências variadas com every other day, once in a while e on weekdays (apartment, cereal, diner, subway, comedy, phone)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende frequências novas: I eat cereal every other day. I go to the diner once in a while. I work on weekdays.
falas: What detail should we keep in mind?
It is a work of art, so the context changes how we read the scene.

alvo.gramatica: How's it going? · Nice talking to you · Take care
alvo.foco: conduzir uma conversa completa com How is it going, Nice talking to you e Take care (how is it going, catch up, nice talking, take care, same here, see you)
alvo.porque: Hoje você junta tudo: How is it going? Let us catch up. It was nice talking to you. Take care. See you soon.
falas: Hi! Long time no see. How is it going?
Good. Let us catch up over coffee.

alvo.gramatica: I'll miss you · Stay in touch · It was great meeting you
alvo.foco: despedir-se com I will miss you, stay in touch e It was great (camp, helicopter, jeep, postcard, toast, sunrise)
alvo.porque: Hoje você se despede do A2: I will miss you, Radar. Stay in touch, please. It was great meeting you.

alvo.gramatica: I couldn't… but now I can… · At first… · I've improved
alvo.foco: mostrar evolução com I could not, but now I can e I am finally able (could not, but now, finally, at first, used to find, improve)
alvo.porque: Hoje você mostra sua evolução: At first, I could not understand. But now I can. I have improved a lot. I can do it now!

alvo.gramatica: I have learned to… · I have learned that… · I now know…
alvo.foco: resumir o aprendizado com I have learned to, I have learned that e I now know (game, backyard, dad, sister, rule, turn)
alvo.porque: Hoje você fecha o A2: I have learned to wait my turn. I have learned that games are fun. I now know the rules.
falas: What detail should we keep in mind?
It is a film, so the context changes how we read the scene.
